scope: Short actual read-only always-muted stock browser Overte Hub cohorts. No endurance, physical microphone, public world writes or universal latency guarantee. Positions, participant IDs, original asset URLs, events and raw device identifiers are excluded.
readinessMeaning: First sampled zero active/queued model tasks and zero compilingGraphics after actual admission; failed tasks still settle, so this is not complete success of every texture. Summed phase waits overlap and are not elapsedCPU/GPU time.
comparisonLimitations: Individual live snapshots; different engine DPRs remain explicit. The final source-cache cohorts retain native geometry and texture inputs and original four fluid thresholds.
